column1: # Files copied from the source repository, and where each one comes from.
#   <path in this repository>\t<path in the source repository>
# docs/ now mirrors the source layout, so those rows are the identity mapping and
# this file records only WHICH files are curated. It stayed explicit through the
# reorganisation, when equal paths no longer meant equal files and equal
# basenames were ambiguous; keeping it means a future move is reported rather
# Two markers instead of a path:
#   REMOVED-UPSTREAM  The source file is gone. Kept here as the as-audited
#                     record and never refreshed. Used for the three referral
#                     distributor specs, whose contracts were deleted before
#   NEEDS-DECISION    Renamed or split upstream with more than one plausible
#                     successor. sync-from-source.sh fails while any remain, so
#                     an unresolved rename cannot pass silently. None currently
#                     open; each was settled by comparing the copied file
#                     against every candidate in the freeze tree, so a rename is
#                     only recorded where the content agrees.
